summary: Iteration 88 - Recurring Invoices & Invoice Templates Module Testing Complete. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all features: stats cards, recurring invoices list, templates tab, create/edit/history dialogs, action buttons, search and filter functionality.
seed_data_creation: Seed data auto-created on first GET to /api/recurring-invoices/list: 6 recurring invoices (ri-001 to ri-006) and 5 invoice templates (it-001 to it-005)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 88 tested the complete recurring billing module overhaul. All backend APIs and frontend UIs working correctly. Key endpoints: /api/recurring-invoices/list (returns 6+ RIs), /api/recurring-invoices/stats (MRR, ARR, active, due_this_week), /api/recurring-invoices/create, PUT/DELETE /api/recurring-invoices/{id}, /api/recurring-invoices/{id}/toggle, /api/recurring-invoices/{id}/generate-now, /api/recurring-invoices/{id}/duplicate, /api/invoice-templates (returns 5 templates), POST /api/invoice-templates, /api/invoice-templates/{id}/apply. Navigation: Finance Center > Recurring Invoices (/recurring-invoices). Page has two tabs: Recurring Invoices and Invoice Templates. Stats show MRR $33,670, ARR $418,040.

recurring_invoices_list.GET /api/recurring-invoices/list: PASS - Returns 6+ recurring invoices with full data (id, client_name, amount, frequency, status, line_items, etc.)
recurring_invoices_list.GET /api/recurring-invoices/stats: PASS - Returns MRR, ARR, active count, due_this_week, by_frequency breakdown
recurring_invoices_list.Frontend: PASS - Page loads with stats cards, tabs, table with 7 rows, action buttons

recurring_invoices_crud.POST /api/recurring-invoices/create: PASS - Creates new RI with line items, calculates subtotal/tax/total
recurring_invoices_crud.PUT /api/recurring-invoices/{id}: PASS - Updates description, line items, frequency, recalculates amounts
recurring_invoices_crud.DELETE /api/recurring-invoices/{id}: PASS - Deletes RI, returns 404 on subsequent GET
recurring_invoices_crud.Frontend Create Dialog: PASS - Opens with client selector, frequency, description, line items editor, tax rate, payment terms, start date, auto-send toggle, notes
recurring_invoices_crud.Frontend Edit Dialog: PASS - Opens with editable fields, line items editor, save changes button

recurring_invoices_actions.POST /api/recurring-invoices/{id}/genera: PASS - Creates real invoice, updates stats (invoices_generated, total_billed)
recurring_invoices_actions.POST /api/recurring-invoices/{id}/duplic: PASS - Clones RI with (Copy) prefix, paused status, reset stats
recurring_invoices_actions.Frontend Action Buttons: PASS - Generate Now, Pause/Activate, Edit, History, Duplicate, Delete all visible and clickable

invoice_templates.GET /api/invoice-templates: PASS - Returns 5 seeded templates with line items, category, usage_count
invoice_templates.POST /api/invoice-templates: PASS - Creates new template with line items
invoice_templates.POST /api/invoice-templates/{id}/apply: PASS - Creates recurring invoice from template for client
invoice_templates.Frontend Templates Tab: PASS - Shows 5 template cards with line items, pricing, Use Template button
invoice_templates.Frontend Apply Template Dialog: PASS - Opens with client selector, frequency, start date, auto-send toggle

search_and_filter.Search: PASS - Filters recurring invoices by client name/description
